encodes: The case babyblueviper1 asked for: an acceptance record paired with a receipt for a different deliverable. It must not link.
provenance: requested in erc-8004/erc-8004-contracts#99 by babyblueviper1 on 18 October 2026: "a vector in which the acceptance record names a different deliverable hash than the receipt it is paired with. It should not link."
description: Identical to the positive control except for one byte of the acceptance record's deliverable hash. Everything else still passes: the sidecar names the right receipt, the checker is independent, and the criteria were committed first. A verifier that reports LINKED here is reading the pair as a whole instead of checking that both halves name the same deliverable, which is the one thing this binding exists to prove.
limits: This proves the pair does not hold together. It says nothing about which of the two artifacts is the wrong one.
